verdict.rationale: Appwrite Functions, its automation surface, can deploy automatically from source control, which implies versioning through git commits. The pack documents no review step or rollback for function deployments. Sites branch previews cover a different product and do not transfer to automations. Missing for 10: documented deployment version history for functions, a review/approval step before activating automations, explicit rollback to a prior deployment, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: deploying automatically from source control... Each function will have its own URL, execute in its own isolated container
These Functions can be triggered by HTTP requests, SDK methods, server events, webhooks, and scheduled executions.
